defs.text: When an army stops fighting and lets the other side win, we say that the army surrenders. Sometimes people wave a white flag to show that they are surrendering.
To submit to a person who has more power.
A gym is a large room or building for indoor sports or exercise.
If you have a crush on someone, you like them and want to date them. This could be because you think they are attractive.
defs.example: I've got a crush on Joey, but you can't tell anyone.

defs.text: The person you have a crush on is called a crush.
defs.example: Cindy was my boyhood crush.

defs.text: To release human liquid waste; to urinate.
defs.example: I am going to pee in that bush.

defs.text: Stress is emotional pressure that makes you worry because things are not going well.
defs.example: Death is a time of great stress for family and friends.

defs.text: Stress is physical pressure that gradually can cause things to break
defs.example: Sitting puts an unnatural stress on the back and shortens the neck.

defs.text: Stress is extra attention or importance that you put on something.
defs.example: Psychology has put a lot of stress on the childhood roots of adult problems.

defs.text: Stress is extra loudness that you use in a word or in music.
defs.example: Put more stress on the first syllable of the word.

defs.text: If you stress something, you say that it is very important.
defs.example: I have repeatedly stressed the importance of hard work, but luck is also helpful.

defs.text: If you stress a word, part of a word, or a note in music, you make it louder than other words or notes.
A cave is a large, naturally-formed hole formed underground, or in the face of a cliff or a hillside.
defs.example: A storm is coming towards us, lets take shelter in that cave.

defs.text: A hole, depression, or gap in earth or rock, which could be natural or man-made.
A storage cellar, especially for wine or cheese.
A collapse or cave-in.
A wing is the long flat part of a bird, insect or other flying thing. It is used to fly.
defs.example: This bird can fly very high very quickly because the bird uses strong wings with many feathers.

defs.text: A wing is part of a building, usually not the main part.
A wing is part of a political group.
If you arrange something, you put it in order or you organise it.
defs.example: We have arranged a meeting between the president of the company and the new owner.

defs.text: Noble qualities are those admired by others.
defs.example: It was very noble of him to defend his friend.

defs.text: If you launch something, you throw it.
defs.example: During the fight, he launched a dart at my head. Luckily, he missed.

defs.text: If you launch a boat, you put it in water.
defs.example: Bob is having a party to launch his new speed boat this weekend.

defs.text: If you launch something, you start it or get it going.
defs.example: The movie star is going to launch her new clothing line next month.

defs.text: a motorboat with an open deck or a half deck
the act of propelling with force
A legend is a story that has been passed down through the years, with no certain starting point, that is part of the history of a place.
A legend is a small bit of truth that has been made to look better than it actually is.
A legend is a person who has done an amazing accomplishment.
A legend is a key to the symbols drawn on a map.
A mix is two or more things that have been mixed together; it is a mixture.
defs.example: Now add the raisins to the mix.

defs.text: The result of combining items normally kept separate.
defs.example: The laundry is a mix of light and dark clothes.

defs.text: The result of combining several tracks.
defs.example: The rhythm mix sounds muddy.

defs.text: The finished version of a recording.
defs.example: I've almost finished the mix for this song.

defs.text: If you mix something, you stir two or more things together.
defs.example: Mix the eggs and milk with the flour.

defs.text: If you mix something, you combine items from two or more sources which are normally kept separate.
defs.example: Don't mix the light clothes with the dark clothes in the washing machine.

defs.text: To combine many tracks.
defs.example: I'll mix the rhythm tracks down to a single track.

defs.text: To make a finished version of a recording.
defs.example: I'm almost done mixing this song.

defs.text: Golf is a game where a person uses a club to try to hit a ball into a hole with the fewest strokes.
defs.example: He played golf with a friend.

defs.text: Golf represents the letter G in the ICAO spelling alphabet.
Imagination is the ability to see something in your mind, or pretend that something false is true.
defs.example: Children use imagination to see sticks as swords and fight monsters.

defs.text: Imagination is the ability to think of something new, different, strange, or unusual.
defs.example: The artist made this amazing artwork by using his imagination.

defs.text: A person's imagination is how creative he can be.
defs.example: The writer was well-known for his creative imagination.

defs.text: A small wild animal that is like a dog.
A pretty woman.
A smart person who can trick other people.
Butter is a firm yellow substance that is made from milk spread on bread or used in cooking.
defs.example: Please pass the butter.

defs.text: A bread and butter issue, is a basic and important one.
defs.example: If we want to win this election, we need to focus on bread and butter issues like jobs.

defs.text: Your bread and butter is the work that you do most and that earns you the most money.
defs.example: Fixing shoes used to be our bread and butter, but today, nobody gets their shoes fixed.

defs.text: taken by a government.
defs.example: The city is raising taxes again.

defs.text: The gross amount is the total before you take away losses or expenses.
defs.example: Her gross pay was $500, but then they took out $60 for tax.

defs.text: A gross violation or abuse is very bad and clearly wrong.
defs.example: Leaving the bank unlocked was an act of gross carelessness.

defs.text: If something is gross is very unpleasant.
defs.example: There was a gross smell coming from the broken pipe.

defs.text: To insist means to get your own way without listening to other people's comments.
defs.example: He insisted on eating out. His wife, therefore, had no choice but to also do so.

defs.text: If something is classic, it's typical.
defs.example: Richard Branson is a classic example of success without schooling.

defs.text: If something is classic, it has a long history and it is liked.
defs.example: His clothes were a mixture of classic and modern styles.

defs.text: A classic is a book, play, song, etc. that has a long history and is liked.
defs.example: Every time a classic like that comes on the radio, I just have to stop and listen.

defs.text: The classics are the language and art from ancient Rome and Greece.
defs.example: You've never read Homer? Schools don't teach the classics these days.

defs.text: When someone is selfish, that person regards himself/herself as the standard in making decisions.
defs.example: John is very selfish and only thinks about himself.

defs.text: A bat is a small, furry animal (a mammal) that has wings and can fly.
A bat is a special stick used to hit the ball in baseball, and in some other games.
If you bat, you swing something or try to hit something.
defs.example: She batted her eyelashes shyly.

defs.text: Print is letters, numerals, punctuation and other similar written symbols.
defs.example: The print size in the newspaper is too small for me to read.

defs.text: A print is a copy that you make with a machine using ink or toner.
defs.example: There were only fifty prints made of this painting.

defs.text: If you print a picture, book, newspaper, etc., you make a copy of it on paper with a machine using ink or toner.
defs.example: The book was printed in December.

defs.text: If you print words or letters, you write them by hand in a block style, not a cursive style.
defs.example: Please print your name here and then sign underneath.

defs.text: A champion is someone who has been a winner in a contest.
defs.example: I was the race and so now I am this year's champion.

defs.text: Therapy is the treatment of impairment, injury, disease, or disorder.
defs.example: My grandfather's therapy will start at the hospital at noon tomorrow.

defs.text: power or quality.
A lifetime is the duration of the life of someone or something.
A sauce is a thick liquid that you put on food to give it a special taste.
defs.example: I put the chicken in a special sauce for two hours before I cook it.

defs.text: A test that is done to prove something, to see if a guess is valid, or to do something that has not been tried before.
defs.example: The experiment will prove that water boils at 100°C.

defs.text: To do an experiment.
If you describe something, you say what it looks like, sounds like, acts like, etc.
defs.example: Their wedding day, as described by Emma in her book, was "a perfect September day."

defs.text: If something describes a circle, arc, etc., it follows that shape.
defs.example: His finger slowly described a circle in the water.

defs.text: Grass is a green, leafy plant that often covers the ground.
defs.example: We haven't got much rain, and the grass on the lawn is turning brown.

defs.text: Marijuana
To break the rules for your own gain.
defs.example: Don't play cards with her, she cheats.

defs.text: To have a relationship with someone not one's spouse or partner or someone who is married to someone else.
defs.example: He is cheating on his wife with his secretary.

defs.text: To avoid something that seemed likely.
defs.example: To cheat death.

defs.text: If you attend something like school or a party, you go to it.
defs.example: I attended a party.

defs.text: If you attend to something, you give attention to it.
defs.example: I attended my brother as best man at his wedding.

defs.text: Homework is practice or study that you are supposed to do outside class.
defs.example: Here is a fun and simple activity to do as a classroom or homework assignment.

defs.text: If you do homework on/about a topic, you find information about it.
defs.example: We didn't do enough homework before buying the car, and it was a big mistake.

defs.text: A servant is someone who works for a person or for a family, doing things like cooking and washing. Often the servant lives in the house where they work. A servant works for the same family all day.
defs.example: This rich family has three servants working for them in their big house.

defs.text: in a way that can be used or has a real effect
defs.example: That's probably true, but practically speaking, it wouldn't work.

defs.text: A very strong metal made of iron and other substances mixed together.
defs.example: All my pots for cooking are made of steel.

defs.text: If you wipe something, you rub it to take something off of it. Often you wipe off water or dirt.
defs.example: I wiped my glasses with my shirt.

defs.text: If you wipe a computer disk, you erase everything from it.
defs.example: I accidentally wiped my hard drive and lost all my documents.

defs.text: A generation, is all the people or things of about the same age.
defs.example: My father belonged to a generation of travellers who saw the world before there was a McDonalds on every corner.

defs.text: A generation is the average time between one when group of people were born and when their children were born, roughly 20–30 years.
defs.example: During previous generations, travel was not so easy.

defs.text: A class or type of objects usually developed from an earlier type.
defs.example: A new generation of personal computers is about to hit the stores.

defs.text: Generation is the creation of something, often electricity.
defs.example: The increase in new power generation has not kept up with demand for electricity.

defs.text: A cabin is a private room or compartment on a ship.
A cabin is a small wooden shelter or house in a wild or remote area.
The section of a passenger plane having the same class of service.
A financial problem, issue, activity or other thing is about money or business.
defs.example: Our sales are down and we have serious financial problems.

defs.text: An industry is a kind of work that makes things.
defs.example: Many people in this country have jobs in the clothing industry.

defs.text: Industry is the quality of working hard, trying hard and doing it well.
defs.example: Because of her industry, she made a lot of money.

defs.text: A bond is a connection between two people because of love or friendship.
defs.example: War can often build strong bonds between people who suffered or fought together.

defs.text: A bond is a connection between two or more things, for example using glue.
defs.example: The heat created a bond between the plastic and the metal.

defs.text: A bond is a financial document promising to pay a certain amount of money. These are often bought and sold.
defs.example: The new benchmark ten-year government bond yielded 6.3%.

defs.text: Things that tie or limit you.
defs.example: It took her many years to break free of the bonds of guilt.

defs.text: A sheep is an animal that people keep on farms and eat for food.
defs.example: My grandfather has a sheep farm and we get all our wool there.

defs.text: A sheep is a person who follows orders blindly and cannot think for themself.
A deck is the floor of a ship.
defs.example: The sailors had to clean the top deck.

defs.text: A deck is the space between the floors of a ship.
defs.example: The cannons were lined up in the gun deck.

defs.text: A deck is something that is like the floor of a ship.
defs.example: We sat on the top deck of the bus.

defs.text: A deck is the outside floor of a house or building without a roof.
defs.example: We went out onto the observation deck at the top of the tall building.

defs.text: Written characters (letters).
defs.example: Russian language uses Greek script fonts.

defs.text: The written text of a movie.
defs.example: The script was developed by a famous screenwriter.

defs.text: A way of in which all of the letters in the same word are connected; cursive.
Short for prescription.
A brand is a red-hot piece of wood in a fire.
defs.example: Don't touch that brand!

defs.text: A brand can be a symbol that means you own something.
defs.example: What cereal brand do you like?

defs.text: A brand is a specific type of something.
We measure an angle using degrees. All the way around a circle is 360 degrees. Often, ° is written instead of "degrees".
defs.example: A right-angled triangle has an angle of 90 degrees.

defs.text: We measure how hot or how cold it is (temperature) using degrees on a scale, such as Celsius or Fahrenheit.
defs.example: It's going to be 35 degrees Celsius today.

defs.text: The amount that an object has of a certain quality.
defs.example: To what degree do the two accounts of the accident agree?

defs.text: Any units used to measure specific gravity, bitterness, darkness, etc. in manufacturing .
If something is painful, is causes pain, either physical or mental.
If a part of your body feels painful, it is affected by pain.
Religion is when a person or persons believe in a God or Gods.
Religion is a set of beliefs about a God or Gods.
defs.example: His religion is Christianity. Mine is Buddhism.

defs.text: An influence is a force that causes something to happen or for someone to do something.
defs.example: Aerosmith has been quite an influence on rock music.

defs.text: An influence is also power to affect or change someone or something by means of position or power.
defs.example: Sometimes, I feel like my parents have so much control that everything and everyone in the world is under their influence!

defs.text: If you influence something, you are forcing something to happen or for someone to do something.
defs.example: Doesn't this calm music just influence you to frolic in a meadow?

defs.text: If you influence something, you can also be changing or swaying it.
defs.example: Vote-stacking can heavily influence an election.

defs.text: Something use to make energy.
defs.example: My car uses gasoline for fuel to make it go. My body uses food for fuel, it's what makes me go.

defs.text: A drawing is a picture.
defs.example: He sketched a drawing of that vase.

defs.text: A drawing is a contest where the person who wins is chosen randomly.
A mammal with long ears.
defs.example: Our pet rabbit liked vegetables and could run very fast.

defs.text: Exercise is a physical activity to make your body stronger.
defs.example: Losing some weight and doing more exercise will improve your looks.

defs.text: Exercise is an activity that helps develop a skill.
defs.example: The next exercise is on page 57 in the textbook.

defs.text: An exercise is an activity for a specific purpose.
defs.example: Her speech the next day was an exercise in damage control.

defs.text: If you exercise your power, your rights, etc. you use them.
defs.example: It's no longer true that men exercise all the power, and women just follow.

defs.text: If you exercise, you do physical activity to make your body stronger.
defs.example: We exercised in the gym.

defs.text: If people or things are attractive, you like them because you think they are good, beautiful, etc.
defs.example: People buy the make-up and stuff they see on television to make them appear more attractive.

defs.text: A virus is a very small thing that can make people sick by getting into a living cell to copy itself.
A computer virus is software that attacks your computer.
If you torture, you cause severe pain to another person.
If something is plain, it is clear and easy to see or understand.
defs.example: The plain and simple truth was that it was John's fault.

defs.text: If something is plain, it is simple and undecorated.
defs.example: This dress is too plain. There is nothing interesting about it at all.

defs.text: If someone or something is plain, they are not beautiful or pretty.
Something that is recent has happened a short while ago.
defs.example: Has there been any recent news on the dispute?

defs.text: If something is sacred, it is put aside for use by religion; it is made holy.
If something is sacred, it is not common; it is holy.
defs.example: The place where the tribe performed their ceremonies was sacred to them.

defs.text: If something or someone is sacred, they are about religion.
If something is sacred, it is given by divine authority.
Separated in time, space, or degree.
defs.example: She's too emotionally removed to understand his feelings.

defs.text: Of a different generation, older or younger.
defs.example: Steve is my second cousin once removed.

defs.text: A robot is a machine that looks more or less a human being.
defs.example: Starwars C-3PO is a golden robot.

defs.text: A robot can also be any man-made automatic device, resembling a human being or not.
defs.example: When you ask for the time on a phone, a robot will answer you.

defs.text: A robot is a person who does not show emotions and seems to have no human thoughts.
defs.example: He has the same expression whatever happens to him: he is a true robot.

defs.text: If something confirms an idea, it show that it is true.
defs.example: The results of the study confirm previous research on the topic.

defs.text: If you confirm a possible agreement or plan, you tell somebody that it is now final and official.
defs.example: Can we confirm that the meeting is at 10:00?

defs.text: If a Christian priest confirms a baptized person, they admit them to full participation in the church.
A mile is a measurement of distance. It is equal to 1.609 km (5280 feet, or 1760 yards).
defs.example: It's about a mile and a half to the school.

defs.text: For ships and airplanes a nautical mile is equal to 1.853 km (6080.20 feet).
You use miles to talk about a long distance.
defs.example: We're miles from home and we have no food or radio.

defs.text: Division is the act of a whole thing into parts.
defs.example: The division of the pie by the children happened with very little fighting.

defs.text: Division is the process or calculation of dividing a number by another number.
defs.example: I've got ten divisions to do for my homework.

defs.text: Divisions are the parts of something after division.
defs.example: There are four divisions (or sections) in a classical pas de deux.

defs.text: A division is a large military unit (group of soldiers)
A scratch is a mark made by a sharp object against another object.
defs.example: I found a scratch on my car, so I had to get paint to cover it.

defs.text: If something is made from scratch, then it was made without anything that existed or was prepared before.
defs.example: It took us all afternoon to make the pizzas from scratch.

defs.text: If you scratch you use a sharp object to make a mark on another object.
If you scratch you rub a part of your body, because you feel an itch.
defs.example: I scratched my back as it felt very itchy.

defs.text: An ending is the last part of something.
A contest is where people do a quiz or play a game to win a prize.
defs.example: He took part in the contest as he wanted to win the first prize.

defs.text: If you contest a position, you engage in a competition for a position of power.
If you contest a decision, you oppose it.
If something is valuable it has great value. That is, it would cost a large amount of money.
defs.example: Gold is a very valuable metal.

defs.text: Distant is far away; at a distance.
defs.example: She liked to travel to distant places.

defs.text: A distant person is someone who is hard to get to know.
defs.example: My best friend is so quiet and distant, even I don't know him too well sometimes.

defs.text: A motion is a movement, often not a big movement.
defs.example: She made a small motion with her hand to get his attention.

defs.text: Electricity is a form of energy that is used to power buildings, lights, and electrical items.
defs.example: You need electricity to turn on the light bulbs.

defs.text: A mammal that lives in water.
defs.example: We saw seals at the theme park performing tricks.

defs.text: A form of signature to represent a person or a company/service.
defs.example: Place this seal on your website and it will be trusted by your visitors.

defs.text: If something is standard, it is typical or usual.
defs.example: The store sells standard American food.

defs.text: A standard is a quality that is the minimum or usual.
defs.example: percent correct is the standard for an A at our school.

defs.text: A standard is a military or ceremonial flag carried on a pole or hoisted on a rope.
If you inform someone of something, you give them knowledge about it.
defs.example: Unfortunately, they did not fully inform the public of the problem.

defs.text: If something informs your opinion, decision, etc., it helps you come to it.
defs.example: Our decision was informed by a good deal of research.

defs.text: A gentle person is kind and careful not to cause damage, pain, or surprise.
defs.example: He used to fight all the time, but I have become much kinder and gentler.

defs.text: If a movement or moving thing is gentle, it moves slowly and softly.
defs.example: There is a gentle breeze and one red leaf falls.

defs.text: A gentle slope or curve changes slowly from flat or straight.
defs.example: The slope was gentle enough that even my grandmother climbed it easily.

defs.text: A gentle voice is quiet and often friendly.
Your status is your level, role, or situation in a group or society.
defs.example: Mike Hooper has retained his status as Liverpool's current No 1 goalkeeper.

defs.text: The status of something is its situation at a particular time.
defs.example: What is the status of the repairs?

defs.text: A purse is a small bag that is used to carry money.
defs.example: That lady is carrying a yellow purse in her hand.

defs.text: Construction is the act of building something.
defs.example: The workers began construction of the new hospital last week.

defs.text: Construction is the way that something is made.
defs.example: The stone construction of these buildings makes them very cold in the winter.

defs.text: In language, a construction is a combination of form and meaning.
defs.example: Spoken English doesn't use as many passive constructions as written English.

defs.text: A construction is a particular way that something is understood.
defs.example: In this book, the meaning of "man" is not a simple natural thing; it is a social construction.

defs.text: A confession is when someone admits to doing something.
defs.example: He gave a confession about the problem.

defs.text: A trigger is the part of a gun that you push with one finger when you want to make the gun shoot.
defs.example: I didn't want to make him angry, because he had his finger on the trigger.

defs.text: A trigger is a little thing that makes something bigger happen.
defs.example: Bad smells are one of the triggers for my headaches.

defs.text: If something is done frankly, it is done in a candid way.
An exit is a way out of a room or building. This usually means a door that people are expected to leave through.
defs.example: Excuse me. Do you know where the exit is?

defs.text: An exit is a small road that takes you off a highway. This is often used for a way off the interstate roads in the United States.
defs.example: The store is just off exit 245.

defs.text: An exit is the act of leaving a place.
defs.example: He made a grand exit, bowing deeply before leaving the stage.

defs.text: If you exit you leave, you go to another place.
defs.example: Please wait until the lights are on to exit the theater.

defs.text: A response is some words or actions that happen as a reaction to something else.
defs.example: We sent a message to them two weeks ago, but there has been no response so far.

defs.text: When two or more people are discussing an idea that they do not agree on, they are having an argument. Often arguments are loud or angry.
defs.example: I thought we should buy the red car. She thought we should buy the blue car. We had an argument about it.

defs.text: An argument can be the reasons behind an idea.
defs.example: An argument for buying a red car is that it would look cooler than a blue one.

defs.text: An argument is an element that is assigned a semantic role in a proposition.
An argument is the independent variable of a function.
The principal thing is the main or most important one.
defs.example: Canada's principal trading partner is the USA.

defs.text: In American English, a principal is the head of a school. (headmaster in British English)
The principal is the most important person in a business, or an artistic group such as a dancers.
Principal is the money that you borrow and must pay back. It does not include interest.
Turkey is a country in western Asia and eastern Europe. Its full name is Republic of Turkey.
A turkey is a bird that is often raised for food.
defs.example: There was a spotting of a flock of wild turkeys in the forest.

defs.text: Turkey is the meat from this bird.
defs.example: Roast turkey was served at Thanksgiving dinner.

defs.text: A clinic is a place to see the doctor for health checkups or to buy medicine.
defs.example: He felt ill yesterday, so he had to visit the clinic to buy some medicine.

defs.text: A adjective used in English.
defs.example: This is an example with vice.

defs.text: an executive officer ranking immediately below a president; may serve in the president's place under certain circumstances
A toy is something that you can play with.
A toy is something that isn't very important or doesn't have much value.
something that is done a lot or happens a lot; something that is ordinary
defs.example: These are my everyday clothes.

defs.text: A generous person is one who gives time or money to help others.
defs.example: Erasmus Darwin was a generous man who helped many people.

defs.text: A gain is the act of getting something.
defs.example: You have nothing to gain.

defs.text: What one gains, as a return on investment or dividend.
defs.example: No pain, no gain.

defs.text: The factor by which a signal is multiplied.
You gain something by getting or receiving it.
A jungle is an area covered in trees.
defs.example: In South America is a big jungle.

defs.text: A link is a connection between two or more things.
defs.example: It's easy to see a close link between studying and good grades.

defs.text: A link is a word or picture on the Internet that you click to go to another page.
It can be short for Lincoln.
If you link two or more things, you make a connection between them.
defs.example: The Northern Ireland economy is closely linked to that of the rest of the United Kingdom.

defs.text: of or about being under the ground
defs.example: Underground water is drying up.

defs.text: secret or not well known
defs.example: The underground music scene is really interesting.

defs.text: in or into hiding or secret operation
defs.example: the organization was driven underground

defs.text: beneath the surface of the earth
defs.example: water flowing underground

defs.text: A product is an item that can be bought.
defs.example: That store sells many different products.

defs.text: The product is the end result of a process, such as someone's efforts or of a certain situation.
defs.example: Skill is the product of hours of practice; His reaction was the product of hunger and fatigue.

defs.text: A product is the number you get when you multiply two other numbers.
defs.example: The product of 2 and 3 is 6.

defs.text: A product is a chemical substance that is made as a result of a chemical reaction.
Beef is the meat of a cow.
defs.example: We're having ground beef for dinner.

defs.text: A beef is a complaint: something that bothers someone, or that someone keeps getting a little angry about.
defs.example: One of my biggest beefs about this place is that you can't get a drink of water here.

defs.text: If something is religious, it is related to or about religion.
defs.example: Religious beliefs can be very important in choosing a marriage partner.

defs.text: If someone is religious, they believe in a religion and follow its rules.
defs.example: Because Buddhism forbids the wearing of shoes on pagoda grounds, the deeply religious Mon troops remain barefoot while climbing a rocky cliff there.

defs.text: If someone is religious about doing something, they do it on a regular schedule or every chance that they get.
defs.example: We have been less than religious about our daily exercise.

defs.text: If you identify something, you say what it is.
defs.example: I showed him the picture and he identified the man as his brother.

defs.text: If x identifies y, x makes it easy to know what y is.
If you identify with someone else, you understand and share their feelings.
If x is identified with y, it is closely connected to it.
A small piece that is broken off of a larger object.
defs.example: A chip of paint fell off the wall.

defs.text: A damaged area of a surface where a chip has broken off.
defs.example: This cup has a chip in it.

defs.text: A token that is used in place of cash when gambling.
defs.example: poker chip

defs.text: A small circuit used in certain electronic devices.
defs.example: computer chip

defs.text: Surveillance is the close observation or monitoring of a person or group.
The normal way of doing something
A set of actions used to perform a trick
defs.example: s all use the same routine to pull the rabbit out of the hat.

defs.text: on the lower or downward side; on the underside of
defs.example: a chest of drawers all scratched underneath

defs.text: under or below an object or a surface; at a lower place or level; directly beneath
defs.example: we could see the original painting underneath

defs.text: If x is underneath y, x is right under, below, or covered by y.
defs.example: The cat was hiding underneath the car.

defs.text: The temperature of something is how hot or cold it is.
defs.example: Today's temperature is 25°C.

defs.text: A tribe is a social group of families and individuals who live together and have a long shared history.
defs.example: Most of the younger members of the tribe grew up speaking Spanish.

defs.text: A deputy is somebody one level down from another person. The deputy helps the other person or does that person's job sometimes.
defs.example: The sheriff posted a deputy to stay until they could get a better look in the morning.

defs.text: A headquarters is the main building in control of whatever is going on in an organization.
A headquarters is a military command center that controls and commands troops.
If two things are equal, they are the same in shape, size, or number.
defs.example: The number of people inside of the store is equal to the number of people outside of the store.

defs.text: Someone who has the same rights as somebody else.
defs.example: I'm your teacher, not your equal.

defs.text: If x equals y, x and y have the same value.
defs.example: Two plus two equals four.

defs.text: If you reckon that something is true, you think that it is true.
defs.example: What do you reckon we should do?

defs.text: If you reckon a number, cost, etc., you guess or calculate the value.
defs.example: I reckon the cost at about $23,000.

defs.text: If you reckon on something, you expect it.
defs.example: Oh dear, we didn't reckon on so many people.

defs.text: If you reckon with somebody or something powerful or difficult person, you deal with them.
defs.example: In today's race, the Ethiopians will be a force to be reckoned with.

defs.text: If two things are related, they are connected to one another.
If someone is related to someone else, they are relatives.
defs.example: My mother and I are related to each other.

defs.text: If something is related, it is narrated or told.
not easy to believe
defs.example: behind you the coastal hills plunge to the incredibly blue sea backed by the Turkish mountains

defs.text: exceedingly; extremely
defs.example: she plays fabulously well

defs.text: An insect of the order Hemiptera (the "true bugs").
Any insect or arachnid may often be called a bug.
defs.example: These flies are a bother. I’ll get some bug spray and kill them.

defs.text: A problem that needs fixing, especially in computing.
defs.example: The computer program has a bug in it.

defs.text: A contagious illness caused by bacteria or a virus.
defs.example: He’s got the flu bug.

defs.text: A nerve is a cell in the body that sends signals. The brain is made of nerves.
defs.example: She can't feel anything with this arm, and can't move her arm, because the nerves were cut in an accident.

defs.text: Nerve is confidence: a feeling of being able to do something.
defs.example: He didn't have the nerve to ask her to dance.

defs.text: of someone whose marriage has been legally dissolved
A stick or rod with a sharp point. A stake is usually hammered into the ground. Often, the stake is tied to rope to connect something (like a tent) to the ground.
defs.example: We used four stakes to hold down our tent.

defs.text: If you have a stake in something it is important to you. Usually, this means it will affect you in some way, so you have a good reason to be interested.
defs.example: I had a personal stake in hunger relief, since family had no food.

defs.text: A port is a place for ships to stop to trade or refuel.
defs.example: The port was bombed by the Japanese during World War II.

defs.text: A port is a socket in a computer where a device can be plugged in.
A nephew is the male child of someone's sister or brother, and is a part of their extended family.
defs.example: My sister just had a baby boy. He is my nephew.

defs.text: When you proceed, you go forward with something.
defs.example: The reporter proceeded with the interview.

defs.text: A landing is a corridor.
A landing is when an airplane touches the runway; coming to earth.
A landing is a platform in the middle of a staircase.
defs.example: We've finally reached the landing halfway up the stairs to the top of the Statue of Liberty!

defs.text: A landing is a place on a shoreline where a boat lands.
A traitor is a person who you believed that he was a friend or an ally and then causes you a great harm.
An outfit is a set of clothing.
defs.example: She wore a fashionable outfit with matching purse and shoes.

defs.text: If someone has patience, they can wait without feeling upset.
defs.example: Andrew has so much patience with the children; I just get so angry with them.

defs.text: A recording is a reproduction of a media file that is stored in a permanent medium.
defs.example: Some scientists have a habit of recording their findings for their future reference.

defs.text: Unwise. A person who is foolish does not have good sense or judgement. They do things without thinking carefully; they do things that are bad ideas.
defs.example: The person who saw and copied my homework today is being foolish.

defs.text: Foolish means someone who is usually foolish. They have the characteristic (quality) of being foolish.
defs.example: Being foolish once in a while does not make a person a foolish one.

defs.text: A costume is the clothes you wear that makes you look like someone or something else.
defs.example: For Halloween this year I wore a skeleton costume.

defs.text: tight fitting garment worn for swimming
If someone or an animal is injured, they are hurt; when something has caused harm to a person or an animal.
defs.example: You're too injured to keep playing.

defs.text: A pet is an animal that is kept by a person for company and friendship.
defs.example: I have 4 pets: 2 dogs, a cat and a fish.

defs.text: A pet is a person who is very loyal to their superior or boss.
defs.example: She's the teacher's pet.

defs.text: A cage is a structure made with wire or bars, to hold an animal.
defs.example: The bird lived in a large wire cage near the window.

defs.text: A cage is a something that holds things in, to protect or to keep imprisoned.
defs.example: Your heart is inside your rib cage.

defs.text: An awkward person or animal is clumsy, lacks agility, dexterity or grace.
defs.example: He doesn't managed well when I try to juggle. He's still awkward.

defs.text: An awkward situation, event is an embarrassing situation, event.
defs.example: When I fell in front of everybody, I felt ridiculous. It was so awkward!

defs.text: Awkward also means complicated.
defs.example: What an awkward device! I can't even imagine how it works.

defs.text: A pattern is a design that uses the same set of elements many times in the same order.
defs.example: The table cloth had a simple pattern of red and white squares.

defs.text: The combined and for an individual or a group of people describes a pattern.
defs.example: The people of Spain have a pattern of resting in the afternoon and eating dinner late at night.

defs.text: If you concentrate on something, you use most of your time and work there.
defs.example: We concentrated our rebuilding efforts on villages in the North of the city, where most of the damage had been done.

defs.text: If you concentrate on something, you think about it and not about other things.
defs.example: I went to a quiet room so I could concentrate.

defs.text: If something is concentrated somewhere, there is a lot of it in that place.
defs.example: The fighting was concentrated in a few small areas.

defs.text: in or at or to some place
defs.example: she must be somewhere

defs.text: An aim is something you want to do or have done.
defs.example: The aim of the study was to find out if these students would talk differently to themselves during independent work.

defs.text: If you take aim at something, you point a gun or other weapon at it.
defs.example: He takes aim and fires.

defs.text: If you take aim at something, you turn your attention to it.
defs.example: The book takes aim at politicians and their wasteful spending.

defs.text: Your aim is your skill in hitting something that you are shooting, throwing, kicking, etc. at.
defs.example: He threw the stone at the bird, but his aim wasn't so good.

defs.text: If you aim at doing something, you plan or try to do it.
defs.example: The new rules for cars are aimed at reducing speeds and improving driver safety.

defs.text: If you aim at something, you point a gun or other weapon at it.
defs.example: He grabbed for his gun, aimed it and started shooting.

defs.text: If something is thick, there is some distance from one side to the other.
defs.example: He was a workman with big hands and thick fingers.

defs.text: If something is thick it has a lot of stuff in it.
defs.example: I am warm because I have a thick coat.

defs.text: If a liquid is thick, it can't flow very quickly.
Sport is physical exercise which involves players playing in a team.
defs.example: What sport shall we play?

defs.text: A sport is a helpful person.
defs.example: Be a good sport and open the door for me.

defs.text: Sport is fun or entertainment.
defs.example: It was good sport to surprise him like that.

defs.text: If something is electric, it uses electricity.
defs.example: My grandmother wrote her letters on a typewriter; my mother used an electric typewriter, and I use a computer.

defs.text: If something is pleasant, it is enjoyable or agreeable.
defs.example: When it rains in the summer, it is a pleasant event.

defs.text: A pleasant person is one who is socially acceptable or polite.
defs.example: The man was pleasant with his smile and quiet laugh.

defs.text: A cliff is a vertical (straight up and down) rock face.
defs.example: Don't go too close to the cliff or you will fall off.

defs.text: A nail is a small, long, thin sharp metal thing for holding wood together. People put it into the wood by hitting it with a hammer.
defs.example: I need some nails to fix the roof.

defs.text: A nail is the thick, hard part at the ends of fingers and toes.
defs.example: I broke the top off my finger nail and it was very painful.

defs.text: The environment is the natural world: forests, rivers, grasslands, oceans, etc.
defs.example: We have to do more to protect the environment from pollution.

defs.text: Your environment is the situation or area that you live, work, or spend time in, including the people, buildings, vehicles, etc.
defs.example: When we moved to the city, we found ourselves in a comepletely new social environment.

defs.text: A western place is in or from the west of the place.
defs.example: Alberta is in Western Canada.

defs.text: A western idea or practice comes from Europe and/or North America.
defs.example: It's hard to explain fully why Western culture has been so successful.

defs.text: To be average is to be not one extreme or another.
defs.example: In football, he is an average player.

defs.text: An average is a measure in the middle of several numbers.
defs.example: The average size of a family in America is about two or three.

defs.text: The state of being comfortable or relaxed.
defs.example: She enjoyed the ease of living in a house where the servants did all the work.

defs.text: from pain, worry, etc.
defs.example: His mind was at ease when he took the test. He knew he had studied well.

defs.text: Free from effort, difficulty or hardship.
defs.example: He passed all the exams with ease.

defs.text: Doing something without much effort.
defs.example: He played the piano with ease.

defs.text: To free or lessen (something) from pain, worry, agitation, etc.
defs.example: He eased his conscience telling her what he had done wrong.

defs.text: To loosen or relax the tension on (something).
defs.example: We eased the rope, then lowered the sail.

defs.text: To reduce the difficulty of (something).
defs.example: We had to ease the entry requirements.

defs.text: To move (something) slowly and carefully.
defs.example: He eased the car into the parking space.

defs.text: If you interrupt someone, you stop them doing or saying one thing, and often ask them to do another.
defs.example: Please, don't interrupt me when I'm thinking.

defs.text: If you are satisfied, you feel happy that you have enough.
defs.example: A satisfied customer will usually come back to your shop in the future.

defs.text: suffering from lack of food
An anniversary is a day that is an exact number of years since a special event.
defs.example: Today is our tenth wedding anniversary.

defs.text: An election is a decision, often decided by voting.
defs.example: The man elected to take part in the work.

defs.text: A person whose job is to fight and kill enemies of their people or country. Often this is used for someone from a long time ago, or to say some is like a hero from long ago.
Someone who is tough or wants to be seen as like a warrior from long ago.
from a particular thing or place or position (`forth' is obsolete)
defs.example: ran away from the lion

defs.text: forward in time or order or degree
defs.example: from that time forth

defs.text: out into view
defs.example: came forth from the crowd

defs.text: If you fetch something, or someone, you go away to get it and return with it.
defs.example: John fetched me a towel from the bathroom.

defs.text: If something fetches a price then it is sold for that amount of money.
defs.example: That old painting fetched more than I expected at the auction.

defs.text: the time when something happens
the regulation of occurrence, pace, or coordination to achieve a desired effect (as in music, theater, athletics, mechanics)
If something is complex, it has lots of parts or pieces, or is difficult to understand.
defs.example: He has constructed a complex computer system to send translated messages between humans and dolphins.

defs.text: If something is frozen it is very cold.
defs.example: Can you get some frozen peas out of the freezer?

defs.text: If something is frozen it is solid and can't move.
If X replaces Y or if you replace Y with X, X now does what Y used to do.
defs.example: Smith will replace the injured Jones for England who are leading 2 to 0.

defs.text: If you replace something, you give somebody a new one because you have broken, lost, or used the old one.
defs.example: I'm sorry, don't know how I'm going to replace your stolen bike.

defs.text: If you replace something, you put it back where it was.
defs.example: After looking at the ring for a while, he carefully replaced it and left the shop.

defs.text: A prayer is when a person tries to communicate with a god he believes in and make requests for help to the god or give him devotion and praise.
An act of overlooking something on purpose.
defs.example: This question has an error. Just skip it.

defs.text: A word similar to jump
defs.example: Squealer skipped from side to side.

defs.text: If someone feels guilt, they feel responsibility for doing something wrong.
A tune is a piece or part of music; a song or melody.
defs.example: Whistling a happy tune can chase the blues away.

defs.text: If you tune a musical instrument you make it so it will play the right notes.
defs.example: You tune it by making the strings tighter or looser.

defs.text: If you tune a radio you set the frequency to get a certain signal.
If you tune-in to a show, you watch it or listen to it.
If you woo someone, you try to get that person to like you, date you or marry you.
The ability to feel whether what you're doing is right or wrong.
defs.example: Even though he stole things, he had some conscience: he didn't kill anyone.

defs.text: If something is done officially, it is done in an official way.
defs.example: He is now officially the president.

defs.text: If you're determined to do something, you have decided you will do it, and you will not let anything stop you.
defs.example: I was determined to make Martin happy.

defs.text: If you hail something, you say it is very good.
If you hail someone, you call them to get their attention.
If it hails, pieces of ice fall from the sky.
If someone is unhappy, they are angry, sad, or depressed; to be upset.
defs.example: There are many unhappy people in the hospital.

defs.text: A small stall to sell items.
An enclosure just big enough to hold one standing person.
defs.example: The man had to use the bathroom booth.

defs.text: If you pour something, you let it flow from one place to another.
If something pours, it flows fast from one place to another.
If the rain pours, it is raining hard (a lot of rain is coming down fast).
filled to capacity
defs.example: a suitcase jammed with dirty clothes

defs.text: pressed together or compressed
defs.example: packed snow

defs.text: A piece of clothing that you can wrap around your body to keep warm.
Something you wrap things in; a wrapper.
defs.example: I bought some giftwrap from the gift.

defs.text: A food wrapped in soft bread.
defs.example: I had a chicken wrap for lunch.

defs.text: You can say, "That's a wrap!" to say you have finished something.
If you wrap something you cover it with something like paper or cloth. This might be done by winding the paper or cloth over it.
defs.example: I wrapped the gifts in paper.

defs.text: If you wrap something up you finish it.
defs.example: We need to wrap up this meeting and get back to work.

defs.text: If you do something on someone's behalf, you do it for them or as their representative.
defs.example: We give you this award on behalf of a grateful nation.

defs.text: A reasonable amount or number is not too much or too big.
defs.example: The hotel has good food, and the prices are reasonable.

defs.text: If something is reasonable, it is fair and sensible.
defs.example: It seems like a reasonable idea to me.

defs.text: The trunk of a tree is the part between the roots and the branches.
The trunk is the long thing on an elephant's face, used for holding things.
A trunk is a large box made from wood that can be locked, used to store things.
In cars, the trunk is the back part, used for storage.
A festival is an organized event that contains a number of performances and usually happens every year.
defs.example: Many actors are in town for the Toronto international film festival.

defs.text: A festival is a period of celebration that marks a special occasion, often religious traditions.
defs.example: Next week our town celebrates the annual winter festival.

defs.text: A tradition is something that has been done in the same way for a long time.
defs.example: Despite a long tradition of education, there is still a lack of qualified teachers

defs.text: A motive is a reason to do something.
defs.example: The man says he has no motive for killing his wife.

defs.text: In some churches a bishop is a senior minister or priest, and is responsible for a diocese.
A bishop is a piece in a game called chess.
A dealer deals or sells things.
A dealer is a negotiator in a car sale.
A dealer sells or deals drugs to people.
A reserve or substitute.
A secondary plan that can be used in case the first plan fails.
close at hand
defs.example: the nearby towns

defs.text: not far away in relative terms
defs.example: she works nearby

defs.text: A benefit is something good that comes from something else.
defs.example: It was her idea, but she received no benefit from the new program.

defs.text: If you benefit from something, you get something good from it.
defs.example: My health has really benefited from all the exercise I'm getting.

defs.text: If you have an adventure you have a trip with a lot of excitement, hazards, or dangers.
defs.example: Bilbo went on an adventure.

defs.text: An adventure may be any event where risks are encountered.
A person's, animal's, or group's territory is land he, she, or they claim, own, or control.
defs.example: The wolf defended its territory.

defs.text: Your territory is what belongs to you. This could mean things, power, mates, or even .
defs.example: Don't move into my territory in this office, especially not in sales.

defs.text: A territory large amount of land, like a country or a state. Often, this means a large piece of land claimed as part of a country.
defs.example: Porta Rico is a U.S. territory, but not a state.

defs.text: An apology is words or actions that show you are sorry.
defs.example: Thank you both very much, and again, my apologies for keeping you both waiting so late.

defs.text: If you make no apologies for something, you think it was the right thing to do.
defs.example: The company president makes no apologies for those high profits, saying people should be pleased the industry is so strong.

defs.text: different
defs.example: They were dressed in an unlike manner.

defs.text: not the same as; different from.
defs.example: This is unlike anything I have ever done before.

defs.text: as a result
defs.example: I didn't do my homework and thus got a bad grade.

defs.text: in this way or manner
defs.example: If you throw the ball thus, as I’m showing you, you’ll have better luck hitting the target.

defs.text: You use thus far to mean until now, or up to this point.
defs.example: Things have gone well thus far. Let's hope they continue.

defs.text: being changed over time so as to be e.g. stronger or more complete or more useful
defs.example: the developed qualities of the Hellenic outlook

defs.text: (used of societies) having high industrial development
defs.example: developed countries

defs.text: (of real estate) made more useful and profitable as by building or laying out roads
defs.example: condominiums were built on the developed site

defs.text: A tube; a round, hollow piece of metal, plastic, or wood.
defs.example: I will fix the pipe.

defs.text: A musical instrument made of a pipe; a flute.
defs.example: He plays the pipe.

defs.text: A tube used for smoking.
defs.example: He smokes a pipe.

defs.text: To be gray in color.
defs.example: That is a gray whale.

defs.text: One of the colors people can see. It is halfway between black and white.
defs.example: I like the darker color of gray.

defs.text: A noun used in English.
defs.example: This is an example with goods.

defs.text: A salad is a food that is made of uncooked vegetables. It is often served with a dressing or vinegar.
To be loyal is to be true to someone; to always tell the truth to someone.
defs.example: Be loyal to me, friend.

defs.text: If you are loyal to someone you are faithful to them.
defs.example: Spot is a loyal dog.

defs.text: An atmosphere is a layer of gasses that surrounds a planet.
The atmosphere is the air in a certain place.
The atmosphere of a place is the mood or feeling of that place.
An atmosphere is a unit of measurement for pressure.
A mouse is a very small animal that is similar to a small rat.
defs.example: The mouse ran across the room.

defs.text: A mouse is a device used to control a computer.
defs.example: He clicked his mouse.

defs.text: toward or in the lower or central part of town
A pit is a big hole in the ground.
defs.example: Don't fall in the pit!

defs.text: A pit is a large seed such as that in a peach.
defs.example: The peach pit is hard. Don't bite it.

defs.text: If food is rotten, it has gone bad.
defs.example: There's no reason to eat rotten apples .

defs.text: If someone is rotten, they are cruel or mean.
defs.example: That rotten old teacher punished the entire class.

defs.text: A paradise is a very pleasant and beautiful place.
An organization is a group of people with a particular purpose (e.g., teams, clubs, churches, etc.)
defs.example: The daycare is operated by a voluntary organization of parents and teachers.

defs.text: Organization is the way that something is put together.
defs.example: The organization of the book is very difficult to understand.

defs.text: An exam is a formal test, usually important and often at the end of a course.
defs.example: Did you pass the English exam last week?

defs.text: An exam is a check done by a doctor to see whether you are healthy or not.
defs.example: I went to the doctor for an eye exam, but she said everything was fine.

defs.text: A type of human-like being with magical powers. In modern stories fairies are small with insect-like wings. In older stories they were human-size and very powerful, and sometimes dangerous.
defs.example: A fairy granted then each a wish.

defs.text: A homosexual man, usually one who is very feminine.
defs.example: I'm not sure that fairy even knows he's male.

defs.text: A comment is a short statement about something; usually it is an opinion.
defs.example: I'm afraid I can't make any comment on the case right now.

defs.text: If you comment on or about something, you say something about it.
defs.example: Commenting on the changes in Peru, the president said he would be watching the situation.

defs.text: When a person or animal has activity, it is active or lively.
defs.example: The sleeping dog did not show much activity.

defs.text: When you have a function to do, you have an activity.
defs.example: The child has many after-school activities.

defs.text: The parts of a building that are strong and that hold the other parts up.
defs.example: Now that the frame is done, we can start on the walls.

defs.text: The strong parts (bones) of a person's body.
defs.example: His starved flesh hung on his frame.

defs.text: Something, often made of wood, around the outside of a picture.
defs.example: The painting was in a beautifully carved frame.

defs.text: The outer part of a stamp's image, usually decorated.
People frame a building when they put together the strong parts while they're building or constructing it.
defs.example: Once we finish framing the house, we'll hang tin on the roof.

defs.text: Someone frames a picture such as a painting or photograph when they add a decorative border.
Someone who is taking a picture with a camera frames something when they carefully put it inside the edges of the picture in a nice way.
defs.example: The director frames the fishing scene very well.

defs.text: To put together words to make a point of view (way of thinking) for understanding or interpretation.
defs.example: How would you frame your accomplishments?

defs.text: A habit is something that you do regularly.
defs.example: John, don't bite your fingernails. It's a bad habit.

defs.text: A habit is what people in certain jobs wear, generally religious jobs. These people can be recognized by their habits.
defs.example: The monk's habit was black.

defs.text: A habit is the form of growth of a plant or, sometimes, an animal.
defs.example: Some corals grow with a branching habit.

defs.text: A shelter is a place which can protect someone from the rain and sun.
defs.example: There is no shelter nearby. I wonder how we can get out of this heavy rain.

defs.text: A flow is a smooth regular movement of a liquid, gas, etc.
defs.example: A major accident is blocking the flow of traffic on Yonge St., just north of Queen.

defs.text: If something flows, it moves in a smooth and regular way.
defs.example: The river flows gently to the sea.

defs.text: When you prevent something, you stop it from happening.
defs.example: To prevent accidents, you must do everything with care.

defs.text: When you lend something to another person, you let them use it, after which they must return it to you.
defs.example: I lent my textbook to Jack to allow him to study from it.

defs.text: If x lends y support, believability, acceptance, etc., x gives it to y.

defs.example: I am confident that I will win.

defs.example: The workers are putting a new roof on the house.

defs.example: Any intelligent person should be able to understand this.

defs.example: That's probably the most intelligent comment I've heard today.

defs.text: If another living thing or a machine is intelligent, it can think in ways that are similar to us.
defs.example: We will not likely find intelligent life of other planets.

defs.text: Pain relief is the reduction of pain.

defs.text: Financial relief is the reduction of debt or taxes, or receiving money.

defs.example: He felt the smooth skin on her cheek.

defs.example: He mixed the flour and water until it was smooth.

defs.text: In football (soccer), a pitch is the place where the game is played.
defs.example: She kicked the ball halfway down the pitch.

defs.example: After high school, he applied to three universities and was accepted by all of them.

defs.example: Some of these Americans moved north and eventually become naturalized Canadian citizens.
